description: Removes a specific label from a Trello card; the label itself is not deleted from the board, only its association with the card.

idCard.description: The ID or short link of the card from which the label will be removed.
idCard.title: Id Card

idLabel.description: The ID of the label to be removed from the card.
idLabel.title: Id Label

name: remove_label_from_card

RemoveLabelFromCardResponse.description:
Response schema for `RemoveLabelFromCard`.

DELETE operation returns 200 OK with an empty or null-like response body.
The response body content is unreliable and used internally by Trello.
Best practice is to validate success using the HTTP status code only.
RemoveLabelFromCardResponse.title: RemoveLabelFromCardResponse
